notes.title: Update #1 Version S.0.4
notes.content:
Story:

Kingdom of Singhasari, previously was a small kingdom centred in east Java, it has now risen, to be a great empire, led by an ambitious king named Kertanegara. His dream is to unite the whole archipelago named Nusantara.
Singhasari has a very strong army who are not afraid of death, with a very strong naval power that controlls the commerce of south Asia

Warriors of Vilvatikta - Features:
•	Classic side view, turn based battle system. 
•	At least 20 Hours of Gameplay. 
•	Old Traditional Indonesian setting and story
•       Mini Games
•	Old School English Comedy
•	All new animated Menu System. 
•	Custom Abilities and strategic battles


What’s Changed in the build since last build?

•	Improved Graphics
•	Graphic Reflections added
•	HD Graphics Added
•	Minor Script Changes
•	Removal of Combo button from normal Attack
•	Cost MP to use Combo in Double and triple attack
•	Stabilised the EXP and HP
•	Credits Added
•	Improved EXP system
•	Improved battle system
•	Added new Combo skill which costs 50 MP
•	Different colour save crystals 
•	You are now able to sleep on your bed in your house.
